source: OpenStreetMap, bundled GeoJSON export derived from sixteen direct OSM API map extracts
focus: Gandhipuram and central Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
notes: Buildings, roads, water, land use, places and points of interest render only from these bundled files; no live Overpass or OSM fetches at runtime. Building heights without OSM tags are deterministic 4–8 m estimates seeded from the feature id.
healthFacilities: Facility names and geometry come from OSM, including Coimbatore Medical College Hospital. Their services, referral relationships, travel times and capacity are unverified; no PHC or sub-centre is invented.
